0.long_answer: The medication that is recommended for the treatment of acute pseudogout and is also used to treat familial Mediterranean fever is colchicine. Colchicine has been used for centuries and is well-established in its use for gout and other crystal-induced arthropathies such as pseudogout. Moreover, colchicine is known to be the treatment of choice for familial Mediterranean fever, helping to reduce the severity and frequency of attacks as well as lowering the risk of complications like amyloidosis. Its anti-inflammatory effects make it suitable for both conditions.
